events.summary: Thalia says Avacyn emerged from the broken Helvault, but her freedom came at a price: Griselbrand.
events.quote: Avacyn emerged from the broken Helvault, but her freedom came at a price

events.summary: With Phyrexia's victory at hand, each sect began perfecting its vision.
events.quote: With Phyrexia's victory at hand, each sect began perfecting its vision.

events.summary: Vorinclex proclaims the revelation of New Phyrexia is at hand.
events.quote: The revelation of New Phyrexia is at hand.

events.summary: A lone missionary marches a pilgrimage through outposts struck by the Eldrazi.
events.quote: a tour of the Eldrazi-stricken outposts across Zendikar

events.summary: Some vampires remind others of their loyalty after the awakening of the Eldrazi.
events.quote: After the awakening of the Eldrazi, some vampires took it upon themselves to remind the others where their loyalty should lie.

events.summary: Vampires fought the Eldrazi and many learned to live among humans.
events.quote: As they fought the Eldrazi, many vampires learned to live among humans.

events.summary: Bolas warns that fear is the last thing one puts faith in.
events.quote: You will fully understand fear when you discover it is the final thing you put your faith in.

events.summary: Bolas claims birth and death are both reversible.
events.quote: Birth and death are both reversible.

events.summary: Tezzeret says Esper can be appreciated only from a distance.
events.quote: Esper, like any work of art, can be truly appreciated only from a distance.

events.summary: Chandra explains she would not ignite things one at a time.
events.quote: Who'd want to ignite things one at a time?

events.summary: Trostani's influence spreads vitality through the Conclave to other guilds' dismay.
events.quote: As Trostani's influence grew, vitality spread through the Conclave

events.summary: Rebels sought to depose the pretender king Lalor the Obstinate.
events.quote: When the rebels couldn't breach the castle to kill Lalor the Obstinate

events.summary: Mirko Vosk hunted anyone with knowledge of the maze.
events.quote: Mirko Vosk hunted anyone with knowledge of the maze

events.summary: Zur remained aloof from Terisiare's suffering.
events.quote: Zur remained aloof from Terisiare's suffering, intent only on his own perfection.

events.summary: Olka collected mist for years and learned to vanish with a thought.
events.quote: Once she learned its essence, she could vanish with a thought.

events.summary: As the Simic released more krasis experiments they displaced locals.
events.quote: As the Simic released more of their krasis experiments, they required new habitats, always at the expense of the locals.

events.summary: Vennick declares the Gateless will fend for themselves, guilds be damned.
events.quote: Guilds be damned. We can fend for ourselves.
